payload.outcome: Both halves are now fixed, in two separate changes. The search half was already done before this session: commit 0496590aa added the alias coverage, with a regression test at tests/smart-search-intent.test.ts recording 0 hits before and 2 after for 'anxiety screening'; it was verified rather than rebuilt. The page-title half was fixed in PR #2887 (merged 2026-09-18) and was not a metadata bug — /calculators/search declares the correct title. It was a stale document.title written by ClinicalDashboard.tsx whose effect is gated on showSharedHome, so the last title written on the shared home survived navigation away. A new use-shared-home-document-title.ts hook now releases the title on unmount, conditionally on it still being the string it wrote, and a new spec asserts the handover — no test asserted a page title anywhere before this.
